summary: Also before upgrading: back up, capture inventory and instance group details, review gateway requirements (2.4 to 2.6 adds platform gateway, new ports and required inventory variables), and fix the 'Error connecting to Controller API' issue behind load balancers by adding the gateway URL to CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGIN and restarting controllers.
